notes: New: the MagicBoard can open a device's web GUI and log you in. Ask Wingman "open <device> and show me its dashboard" (e.g. Catalyst Center) — it opens the page in an embedded browser, trusts the device's self-signed cert, signs in with your saved credential, and shows a live step log. Read-only and crash-free (it drives its own view, not your external browser). First slice of a bigger "drive the page for you" capability.
